title: Finite-free compact-support coefficient comparison and composition
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $E\subset L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation rings $R,S$, uniformizers $\pi,v$, and ramification index $e$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For $n\ge1$ put $A_n=R/\pi^n$ and $B_n=S/\pi^nS=S/v^{en}$, a finite free $A_n$-algebra [lem-coef-finite-free-extension]. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be separated finite-type morphisms of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work with ordinary constant-coefficient module sheaves on fixed small pro-etale skeletons [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. For $C=A_n,B_n$ use the full subcategory $D^b_{ctf}(W,C)$ of bounded constructible complexes of $C_W$-modules having finite Tor amplitude: there exist integers $a\le b$ such that tensoring with any degree-zero $C_W$-module sheaf has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Put $T_{W,n}=-\otimes_{A_n}^LB_n$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Fix compactifications for $f,g,gf$, and let $F_{h,C}=Rh_{!,C}$ be the compact-support functors defined by $Rp_*j_!$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Use the bounded constructible etale-origin realization of [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin]. Let $\gamma_{g,f,C}:F_{g,C}F_{f,C}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{gf,C}$ be their canonical compact-support composition isomorphisms [thm-sf-comp-composition]. For $h=f,g,gf$, let $\alpha_{h,n}:T_{\operatorname{target}(h),n}F_{h,A_n}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{h,B_n}T_{\operatorname{source}(h),n}$ be the canonical finite-free comparison. On bounded constructible etale-origin witnesses it is obtained by composing the open-extension tensor comparison of [lem-coef-etale-open-tensor] and the proper direct-image projection comparison of [lem-coef-finite-free-extension]; its finite constructible pro-etale realization is the transported map under [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison] and [lem-sf-comparison-open-tensor-coherence]. After forgetting $B_n$-coefficients its map in a finite free basis is finite-sum distributivity. Then, for every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A_n)$, the following equality of specified maps $T_{Z,n}F_{g,A_n}F_{f,A_n}K\to F_{gf,B_n}T_{X,n}K$ holds:
$$\gamma_{g,f,B_n,T_{X,n}K}\circ F_{g,B_n}(\alpha_{f,n,K})\circ\alpha_{g,n,F_{f,A_n}K}
=\alpha_{gf,n,K}\circ T_{Z,n}(\gamma_{g,f,A_n,K}).$$
For a normalized derived $A_n$-coefficient system $K_\bullet$ whose levels lie in these finite-Tor constructible categories, the same equation is an equality of the specified maps in the simultaneous derived semilinear-section models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Here normalized means that every transition-adjoint map $K_m\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n\to K_n$ for $m\ge n$ is an isomorphism. The maps use the strict quotient transitions and one fixed $R$-basis of $S$ reduced at every $n$; the assertion is about these coherent constructions before total limit, not equality inferred solely from equality at each evaluation.

proof.text: The implemented preliminary comparisons are proved directly. Quotient induction shows that coefficient inclusions commute with adjacent quotient maps. Naturality of constant sheafification gives the coefficient-ring square for ordinary direct image. The generic pushforward composition isomorphisms produce its identity-on-sections restriction comparison; sectionwise extensionality proves uniqueness. For finiteTensorOrigin, take a bounded-below etale-origin witness and transport the input Tor interval across its isomorphism. Reflect that interval through the site comparison using the proved source-library torAmplitudeIn_mapDerivedCategory_iff API of [lem-exc-comparison-tor-interval]. The etale scalar/tensor comparison of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] makes scalar extension bounded below. The scalar/site comparison and scalar adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility] identify its realization with the chosen pro-etale scalar extension. The adjunction unit and the supplied CoefficientTensorModel are universal, so the unique unit-preserving map between them is invertible. Transport the bounded-below origin along that isomorphism. This preliminary assertion uses finite Tor amplitude, without a finite-free basis.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A6; blueprint paragraph 8, etale-origin and scalar-extension preliminaries

proof.text: For pullRestrictionInv_isIso, evaluate the ordinary restriction square at each coefficient index. RestrictionEvaluation_existsUnique and the section-normalized ordinary direct-image evaluation comparison identify the two pasted right-adjoint squares: all their maps are the identity on underlying sections. The finite-level inverse mate is the proved constant ring-sheaf scalar restriction pullback comparison. The inverse mate of each evaluation square is invertible by the unit-normalized moduleEvalG comparison. The mateEquiv vertical-pasting identity and cancellation of invertible evaluation mates make the evaluated pullback restriction mate invertible. After applying the conservative forgetful functor to underlying abelian presheaves, invertibility on evaluations supplies invertibility at every presheaf component, proving the specified pullRestrictionInv is invertible. No finite-free hypothesis is needed for this auxiliary theorem, and no equality of derived morphisms is inferred from evaluation.

source.place: Tags 03CZ, 03D7 and 03EK; blueprint paragraph 8, scalar restriction preliminaries

proof.text: For finiteLevelComposition apply [lem-pur-finite-free-compact-composition] on the pro-etale site with positive exponent n+1 and the actual arrow from the base stage to upperStage. The lower_preserves field supplied by [lem-pur-finite-coefficient-adjoint-comparisons] makes Rf_!K constructible of finite Tor amplitude; apply the same finite-free theorem to g and gf to obtain all three coefficient isomorphisms. Each universal CoefficientTensorModel receives the unique unit-preserving isomorphism from the scalar left adjoint. Transposing under the scalar adjunction proves that these isomorphisms intertwine compactSupportCoefficientComparison and coefficientMap, and that they intertwine the model map with scalar functoriality. The chosen self compactification change is identity by the existing site comparison square and the etale identity law of [lem-pur-compact-support-site-coherence]. Thus compositionReal at the chosen compactifications is originCompositionModel. The defining fully faithful preimage and naturality of the compositor of [thm-sf-comp-composition] identify composition at every retained origin witness with originCompositionAmbient. Conjugate the finite-free equation by the four unit-preserving tensor isomorphisms and cancel the source isomorphism. This proves the specified B-linear equation for all tensor presentations, without any faithfulness assertion for scalar restriction.

proof.text: By [lem-coef-finite-free-system-restriction], $B_\bullet$ is normalized, constructible of Tor amplitude $[0,0]$, and $h^*B_\bullet=B_\bullet$. Use the whole-system compact-support realizations of [lem-coef-finite-adjunction-diagram-realization]. By [lem-coef-system-scalar-projection-identification], their specified coefficient maps $\widetilde\alpha_h$ restrict to $\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{h,-,B_\bullet}$, as constructed system maps, and evaluate to $\alpha_{h,n}$.

source.place: paragraph 8, assembly Step 2; extracted obligations are statement-only nodes

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-system-level-projection-formula-coherence] to $M=K_\bullet$ and $N=B_\bullet$. Put $\phi=\widetilde\gamma_{g,f,B}\,\mathcal F_{g,B}(\widetilde\alpha_f)\,\widetilde\alpha_g$ and $\psi=\widetilde\alpha_{gf}\,T_Z(\widetilde\gamma_{g,f,A})$. The identification of Step 2 and preservation of compositors by [lem-coef-finite-free-system-restriction] identify its two sides with $U_Z\phi$ and $U_Z\psi$, respectively; hence they agree in $D(\mathscr S_{A,Z})$. Both $B$-system maps have source $T_ZP$, where $P=\mathcal F_{g,A}\mathcal F_{f,A}K_\bullet$. The same restriction lemma gives $T_Z\dashv U_Z$: the two transposes are $U_Z(\phi)\eta_P=U_Z(\psi)\eta_P$, so adjunction gives $\phi=\psi$. This uses no faithfulness of $U_Z$.

proof.text: The realization in Step 2 allows the compactifications fixed in the statement. The refinement square, identity and cocycle assertions of [lem-coef-system-scalar-projection-identification] identify the coefficient maps under every canonical change of these choices. Thus Step 3 concerns the specified maps for the fixed choices. The simultaneous operations of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] realize this equality in the stated section models; evaluation gives Step 1 again. Equality was proved before evaluation and before total limit.
